'''Central circuit matrix''' were [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] systems utilized on [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing's]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]]. The central circuit matrix was connected to the entire [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] and linked to the flight, engine, and power systems. The [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] assigned to the craft connected directly to the system, and enabled the droid to monitor all of the connected systems.<ref name="SWS" />
